dossier.title: Adamenko planetary-radiation pyramid program + the orthodox-journal citation trail that reads the other way (RU->EN)
dossier.key_finding: The ru shape-power lane's only genuine mainstream-journal citation is a MISCITE by its own advocates: the actual paper is Ivanitskii & Narimanov, 'An explanation of the pyramid effect', Biophysics 47(5):943-952 (2002) — a controlled SKEPTIC result. Cardboard pyramid 40x40x24.5cm vs 26cm cube: water evaporates 1.6x faster in the pyramid (folk observations replicate), but a six-parameter thermal-geometry equation explains it — hollow pyramids are simple heat engines driven by diurnal temperature swings. Also documented: Adamenko/Berdyshev 2005 'pyramids as concentrators of planetary radiation' (proportion=spectrum design variable: Cheops 0.637 / Adamenko 1.27 / Golod 2.08), the planeto-meter instrument program with UA declaration patents 42280A/48420A (instrument-NAMED, never instrument-SPECIFIED — patents unfetchable from cloud, citation-only), the dose-metered therapy rig (phase chosen by disease), Adamenko's hadron-radiation mechanism (stimulated decay T=0.69/(ap), K-capture denial, pyramid-block levitation), and the Kurik 2008 Kyiv rotating-apex pyramid-therapy study. Cheapest unrun experiment: the planeto-meter bake-off — four candidate detectors (quartz/semiconductor/ferrite rod/optical fiber) read simultaneously over 24h; never attempted in 20 years.
